body:
## Pull request overview

This PR implements three coordinated roadmap items that advance the Airtable-style UX and dashboard infrastructure: ViewDesigner drag-to-reorder (P1.1), config panel primitives extraction (P1.10 Phase 0), and DashboardConfig types with validation (P1.10 Phase 5).

**Changes:**
- Replaces arrow buttons with `@dnd-kit` drag handles in ViewDesigner column list, matching the pattern used in NavigationRenderer
- Extracts ConfigRow and SectionHeader from ViewConfigPanel into reusable `@object-ui/components/custom` primitives
- Adds comprehensive DashboardConfig TypeScript types and Zod validators using shared constants for single source of truth

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 15 out of 16 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-designer/src/ViewDesigner.tsx | Implements drag-to-reorder with new SortableColumnItem component, DndContext setup, and selection tracking in handleDragEnd |
| packages/plugin-designer/src/__tests__/ViewDesigner.test.tsx | Adds 5 tests verifying drag handles, absence of arrow buttons, read-only behavior, and compatibility with existing features |
| packages/plugin-designer/package.json | Adds @dnd-kit/core, @dnd-kit/sortable, `@dnd-kit/utilities` dependencies (^6.3.1, ^10.0.0, ^3.2.2) |
| packages/components/src/custom/config-row.tsx | New reusable ConfigRow component with label/value layout, clickable button mode, and className support |
| packages/components/src/custom/section-header.tsx | New reusable SectionHeader component with collapsible mode, chevron icons, and aria-expanded accessibility |
| packages/components/src/custom/index.ts | Exports new ConfigRow and SectionHeader components |
| packages/components/src/__tests__/config-primitives.test.tsx | Adds 12 tests covering both ConfigRow (5) and SectionHeader (7) rendering modes and behaviors |
| apps/console/src/components/ViewConfigPanel.tsx | Migrates from inline ConfigRow/SectionHeader definitions to imported components from `@object-ui/components` |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx | Updates mocks to support new ConfigRow and SectionHeader imports |
| packages/types/src/designer.ts | Adds DASHBOARD_COLOR_VARIANTS and DASHBOARD_WIDGET_TYPES constants, DashboardColorVariant/DashboardWidgetType types, DashboardWidgetConfig and DashboardConfig interfaces |
| packages/types/src/index.ts | Exports new dashboard types and constants |
| packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts | Imports shared constants and adds DashboardWidgetConfigSchema and DashboardConfigSchema with enum validation |
| packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts | Exports new dashboard Zod schemas |
| packages/types/src/__tests__/dashboard-config.test.ts | Adds 16 tests covering TypeScript type usage (5) and Zod validation (11) for dashboard configurations |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Updates lockfile with `@dnd-kit` dependencies for plugin-designer |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks P1.1 drag-to-reorder, P1.10 Phase 0 primitives, and P1.10 Phase 5 types as complete; updates test count from 5,070+ to 5,100+ |
</details>
